titre: Severe trauma in crashes: head injury, bleeding and shock
resume: Burning in a car crash is one of the leading causes of accidental death, but the main reason people die in a collision is severe trauma, especially to the head. A severe traumatic brain injury can kill without pain, while internal bleeding causes severe pain then shock, broken bones make victims scream for mercy, motorcycle accidents often involve amputation, and shock leaves only a 20 to 50% chance of survival even at the emergency room.
